performance.verdict: $542 spent across 28 days; zero leads confirmed — tracking or landing page is broken.

findings.text: 28-day lead drought: $541.84 spent, 121 clicks, 0 conversions recorded anywhere — paid channel is flying blind.
OVERDUE (Jul 20 + Aug 31): Stripe QA, GHL 5-gap build, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch all unverified — 5 milestones past due.
GBP actions fell -33% week-over-week (last 3 days show 0 actions vs prior-3 avg of 4) — organic demand signal is also going dark.
686 GA4 sessions in 28 days with 0 GA4 conversions: traffic reaches the site but no conversion event fires — pixel or form is broken.
GHL shows 115 opportunities created at $0 value and 0 won — pipeline exists but no money is moving through it, consistent with zero lead intake.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking and landing page form — zero leads from 121 clicks confirms a break.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $541.84 over 28 days producing 121 clicks and zero recorded conversions — GA4 also shows 0 conversion events from 686 sessions, confirming the form or pixel is broken, not the ads. Audit the conversion tag firing on the landing page form and test a live submission end-to-end. Success = at least one conversion event confirmed in GA4 and Google Ads within 48 hours of the fix. Deadline: 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget scaling until F1 (zero conversions) is resolved; re-check spend efficiency on 2026-09-08.
